resources.string: Your fingerprint or the phone\'s PIN, pattern or password. Android checks it; Svitlyna never sees it.
Set a PIN, pattern or fingerprint for the phone first.
The phone has no screen lock any more, so the app lock was turned off.
Ask for the fingerprint or the phone\'s PIN to open Svitlyna and its photo chooser. Within half a minute it doesn\'t ask again; the app is hidden in recent apps.
Reading the text on the photo…
No text found on this photo.
tap words or run a finger over them
Text on photos is read on the phone (while charging and not in use) and kept encrypted, so the search line finds it: word forms, Latin letters, dates in words. Turning it off erases what was read.
The rest is read while the phone is charging and not in use.
Reading goes on while Svitlyna is open; the rest while charging.
Turn off reading text on photos? What was read is erased; search by text won\'t work.
Looking for personal details in the text…
Tap a found detail to show or hide it. Drag a finger to black out any other area; tap it to remove.
This photo has a location: the copy you send won\'t. No other metadata goes either.
The copy you send has no metadata (no location, camera or dates).
The text wasn\'t checked (stopped, took over a minute, or couldn\'t be read). Look the photo over yourself or black out areas by hand.
No card or phone numbers, e-mail, IBAN, car plates or addresses found in the text. Check faces and places yourself.
Only the top part of this very long screenshot was checked.
Copy its text. Tap to open.
Save without bars or copy its text. Tap to open.
Couldn\'t save a copy without bars
Next to the screenshot, with the same date. Tap to open.
A notification: tap it to open the screenshot, or use "Without bars" and "Text". No picture of the screenshot in it, and on the lock screen only "Svitlyna". Your screenshot itself is never changed.

Right after each screenshot a copy without the status bar (and the navigation bar, if chosen above) is saved, with no tap; works without hints too. The original stays next to it. In full-screen apps (video, games) there is no status bar, so the top of the picture would be cut: use the button instead.
Long screenshot saved next to the first one
Too long for one picture: try fewer screenshots.
These screenshots don\'t seem to overlap (take each one so it shows a bit of the previous one). Put them simply one under the other?
A file that can\'t be cleaned of its location was not handed over (turn secure sharing off to send it as is).

Photos from messengers often lose the date they were taken and jump to the day they were saved. Svitlyna reads the date from the file name and writes it into the photo (only the date: the picture and everything else stay). Android asks you first.
Every photo already has its date, or its name doesn\'t say one.
To edit, first take the photo out of the vault: an edited copy would be saved unencrypted.
No photos from this day yet
Offers to move old screenshots to the trash (Android asks to confirm). "Keep" in the photo menu stops a screenshot from being offered.
